_comment: Enchantments: charms worked into worn pieces at an enchanting table, for Magic. 'slots' is what each fits, 'level' the Magic level to work it, 'xp' what it pays, 'inputs' what it costs, and 'value' what it adds to the piece's worth. The game builds an enchanted twin of every piece each one fits -- copper_ring+keenness, the Copper Ring of Keenness -- so an enchanted piece is an item like any other (see ItemDatabase::LoadEnchantments). Every charm has to be learned first: Mira teaches the first, the rest are scrolls, read from the pack like a brew's. 'from' is what the table says about an unlearned one.
